title: Passiveness
summary: P'ASSIVENESS, noun Quality of receiving impressions from external agents or causes; as the passiveness of matter. 1. Passibility; capacity of suffering. We shall lose our passiveness with our being. 2

inlines.v: P'ASSIVENESS, noun Quality of receiving impressions from external agents or causes; as the passiveness of matter. 1. Passibility; capacity of suffering. We shall lose our passiveness with our being. 2. Patience; calmness; unresisting submission.
